title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Solid Geometry
subject: Mathematics

questions.q:
Michael has a cylindrical fish tank, shown, that has an inside diameter of 18 inches. When he put colored gravel in his fish tank, the water level of the tank rose 2 inches. What is the volume of the gravel in cubic inches?

![Diagram showing a cylindrical fish tank. The inside diameter is labeled 18 in. There is water inside and some fish.](/usa/act/assets/fish_tank_cylinder.svg)
questions.explain: The volume of the gravel is equal to the volume of the water it displaces. The displaced water forms a cylinder with the same diameter as the tank (18 inches, so radius $r = 9$ inches) and a height $h = 2$ inches. Using the volume formula for a cylinder $V = \pi r^2 h$: $V = \pi(9^2)(2) = \pi(81)(2) = 162\pi$ cubic inches.
